hints.TestCenteredAvg: Sort a COPY (slices.Clone, then slices.Sort), drop the first and last element, then average the rest as float64. If fewer than 3 numbers, return 0.
hints.ExampleYears: Example funcs compare printed output to the // Output: comment. Fix Years and this passes.

quiz.q: Which signature makes a function a test?
What makes an Example function verify its output?
quiz.why: Without an // Output: comment the example is compiled but not run.

quiz.q: A doc comment for func Years should start with...
quiz.why: Doc comments begin with the name of the thing being documented.

quiz.q: How do you see coverage in your browser?
options: go test -coverprofile c.out, then go tool cover -html=c.out
quiz.why: Write a profile, then render it.

quiz.q: What is the difference between t.Error and t.Fatal?
options: Fatal stops the current test immediately; Error keeps going
quiz.why: Use Fatal when continuing makes no sense (e.g. a nil result you would dereference).
